sources.title: Training a 125M-parameter Model to Autocomplete Piano
sources.snippet: TL;DR: I trained a 125M-parameter transformer to autocomplete piano performances in real time (~108 notes/sec on an iPhone 15). The biggest improvements came from finding the right MIDI representation, cleaning the training data aggressively, and adding DPO post-training.
